C0577.title: Fuzhou Click Farming Case: Four Convicted of False Advertising
C0577.summary: In August 2025, the Taijiang District People's Court in Fuzhou disclosed a food-delivery click-farming case. The defendants, including Huang, operated a workshop controlling more than 150 mobile phones to fabricate orders and positive reviews for merchants. They generated 123,181 fake orders with a false transaction amount of more than RMB 7.13 million and illegal gains of more than RMB 400,000. The court convicted four defendants of false advertising and sentenced them to detention plus fines.
